name: Fishers Of Men
overview: The call to be 'fishers of men' originates in Jesus' invitation to Simon Peter and Andrew as they were casting nets by the Sea of Galilee, promising to transform their earthly occupation into a divine mission of gathering souls (Matthew 4:18-19; Mark 1:17). This metaphor highlights the active, intentional pursuit of people for the kingdom of God, echoing the urgency of proclaiming God's word as Jesus taught by the lake of Gennesaret (Luke 5:1). The Great Commission further expands this calling, commanding believers to disciple all nations through teaching and baptism in the triune name (Matthew 28:19), underscoring the comprehensive scope of evangelism rooted in Christ's directive.
